findings.message: Hero headline is 14 words ("المنظومة الاحترافية المنظومة الاحترافية لأتمتة بوتات تيليجرا"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "v2026.11" (pill) above "المنظومة الاحترافية المنظومة الاحترافية "; "INDEX · 8 DOORS" above "كل قسم له صفحته، وكل صفحة لها سبب"; "FREE TRIAL" above "ثلاثة أيام تكفي لتعرف"; "LATEST WRITING" above "أحدث ما كتبناه"; "DIRECT LINES" above "قناة واحدة، وردّ من إنسان"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "EDGE GLOBAL", ":", "ONLINE", "(TLS 1.3)"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "00 / 08", "08", "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 42 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "EDGE GLOBAL", "ONLINE", "SANAA", "ZEIDEXSOFT").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✔
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-x-0 → radial-gradient(110% 70% at 50% -10%, oklab(0.57632 -0.116273 0.0342577 / 0.09), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 62%) | div.absolute.left-0 → radial-gradient(rgba(11, 143, 101, 0.3) 1.1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1.1px) | span.aurora-blob → radial-gradient(circle, oklab(0.57632 -0.116273 0.0342577 / 0.13) 0%, oklab(0.57632 -0.116273 0.0342577 / 0.04
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 15 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65) 0px 14p | figure.panel.ticks → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(18, 38, 27, 0.3) 0px 24px 6 | a.card.group → rgba(18, 38, 27, 0.04) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(18, 38, 27, 0.22) 0px 18px 34px -26
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 14 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.fixed.inset-x-0 1440px | div.relative.flex 451px | div.grid.grid-cols-3 451px | div.relative.mt-10 1144px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 16 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "سلسلة SHA-256" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "PostgreSQL 18 مدمجة" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "TLS 1.3" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "ZATCA · المرحلة الثانية" 4.2:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 11px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 68 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 0% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "ZEIDEXSOFT" (14px from the right); "/ 08" (14px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 10 different lines (937px, 1008px, 1119px, 245px, 787px, 877px, 905px); the three most used hold only 46% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "المنظومة" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "الاحترافية" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "لأتمتة" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "بوتات" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
